title: Inherited retinal disease: first Genome v1 panel
note: D5 (the final first-panel gene list) is unresolved. Only RPE65, the recorded first condition (Vision decision 1, 2026-10-19), is listed. A candidate list of about ten genes is proposed in docs/genome/GENOME_V1.md for confirmation and is deliberately not entered here. This panel is not clinically approved, not validated, and not diagnostically complete.
